keyFindings.description: The envoy-session-stall job's setup-go (line 1641-1644) keeps cache-dependency-path, so every pull-request run saves a Go cache entry under refs/pull/<n>/merge. Main's #2328 (INFRA-584), brought in by the merge 790a7969, changed every other setup-go that caches to cache: false plus an actions/cache/restore and a main-only actions/cache/save (pi-legion :865-930, envoy-infra-go :1202-1247, envoy-e2e-local :1582-1618; rule 5 of docs/solutions/github/only-main-saves-an-actions-cache-...-INFRA-584.md). This job is now the only one that writes PR-ref entries, which no other PR reads and which push main's entries out. Use envoy-e2e-local's pattern with the go-envoy key family.

The implementer's proof line records the row C negative control at 790a7969 as 'reconnect none ... (fail) [60261.41ms]', the round-2 figure at 4 MiB. The tester's test.json records that it does not reproduce on Bun 1.4.4 (main's pin): 4 MiB drains, so row C passed without the patch until a5a67218 raised it to 32 MiB. A proof's negative control must be one observed at the head it names; re-run it at the new head (32 MiB, protocol.js hunk reverted) and record what was seen.
Cleanup still open from round 2 (Fast-follow): closedAt doc does not say a paused connection never records its close; dead frozen guards in the data handlers.
Cleanup still open from round 2 (Fast-follow): RECOVERY_BOUND_MS duplicated in nats-stall.test.ts and a bare 60_000 in envoy-channel-stall.test.ts.
Cleanup still open from round 2 (Fast-follow): name handleAuthError as the other caller of the patched disconnect().
